checksums.name: profile_crc16_xmodem_seed0
checksums.formula_detail: CRC-16 MSB-first poly 0x1021 init 0x0000 no reflection no final XOR (XMODEM params, zero seed): crc=(crc<<8)^table[((crc>>8)^byte)]; computed by FUN_08031520(0, profile, 0x9C) via FUN_08022bf0; stored u16le at profile+0x9C. Offsets given for slot_0; covered/stored shift by +0xA0 per slot. File image is byte-reversed within each 8-byte block, so slot_0 stored bytes appear at file 0xA2-0xA3 swapped.

io_driver_functions.notes: DMA3 engine: programs src/dst/count|0x80000000 via pointer globals, busy-waits, restores IRQ state. Used for both EEPROM directions.
EEPROM read one 8-byte block: address bitstream DMA to 0x0D000000, DMA read 0x44 halfwords, reassemble 4xu16 MSB-first. Callers 0x0800a850/0x0800a8d0 via func_ alias (not in callgraph.json).
EEPROM write one 8-byte block: data+address bitstream DMA to 0x0D000000 (addr_bits+0x43 halfwords), then EEPROM busy poll with timer timeout 0x88.
Verify: EEPROM-read block and compare 4xu16 vs RAM; returns 0x8000 on mismatch.
Verified write: up to 3x write (0x0803b150) + verify (0x0803b2c4). Caller via func_ alias.
Load: sequential EEPROM block reads (func_0x0803b0a0) into save buffer+0xC, +8 bytes per block.
Flush: per block EEPROM-read-compare vs RAM; write+verify (0x0803b31c) only on mismatch (write-if-dirty).
Table-driven CRC-16 MSB-first; profile call sites pass seed 0, len 0x9C. Callers via func_ alias for 0x08022bf0 path.
Validate profile: header==occupied magic AND CRC(profile[0:0x9C])==u16 at +0x9C.
Game state -> profile (all field writers, header, CRC). Caller via func_ alias (decompiled.c:1511).

open_questions: Gameplay semantics of profile fields: which game concepts the FUN_08014exx/FUN_080149xx/FUN_08014994 getters represent is not recoverable from this corpus (opaque offsets used throughout).

Exact EEPROM block count in *_DAT_0800a880/*_DAT_0800a908: at least 61 blocks (488 bytes) are meaningful; FUN_0800a90c(0x1000) storing 64 hints the driver may transfer 64 blocks including the 0xFF tail.
Absolute EWRAM address of the save buffer: *_DAT_080xxxxx literal-pool targets are not present in the corpus, so RAM mirrors are reported relative to buffer base +0xC.

Whether the occupied profile header 0xC0DE612D varies by slot index (only slot 0 is occupied in both samples) and the exact semantics/modulus of the global counter byte at +4 (both samples show 0x01).
Unit size of the 6-unit copy at profile +0x44 (FUN_08001e48) and entry semantics of the 5x15 table region at profile +0x14 and the 14-unit block at profile +0x60.
No paired .ss save states exist in this corpus (states/ is empty), so all load predictions in the fuzzing plan remain untested against emulation.
